card.name: Time units in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: The time unit (mostly week or weeks) right after a number or 'each/per' in dosing schedules, such as 'every 3 weeks'. It also fires on other units of time or volume after a number.

modes.description: The word week or weeks closing a repeat-interval phrase in a dosing schedule.
